description: A Java class 'Lines' for reading, parsing, and managing lines from a file, supporting operations like reading all lines, iterating, rewinding, and creating sub-ranges for parsing.

classes.name: Lines
classes.description: A generic class for handling a list of lines from a file, supporting reading, iteration, rewinding, and sub-range creation.

methods.name: readLines(File file)
methods.description: Reads all lines from a file into a Lines object.

methods.name: readLines(BufferedReader in)
methods.description: Reads all lines from a BufferedReader into a Lines object.

methods.name: Lines(ArrayList<? extends Line> list)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a list of lines.

methods.name: Lines(ArrayList<? extends Line> list, int min, int max)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a list and a specific range within it.

methods.name: hasNext()
methods.description: Checks if there are more lines to read within the current range.

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Returns the next line or null if none are available.

methods.name: rewind()
methods.description: Moves the read position back by one.

methods.name: rewind(int pos)
methods.description: Sets the read position to a specific index.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the number of lines in the current range.

methods.name: copy(int from, int to)
methods.description: Creates a new Lines object restricted to a sub-range of lines.
